description: Defines the HttpAuthCache class for storing and managing HTTP authentication entries, including nested Entry class, with methods for lookup, add, remove, and update of auth cache entries, and internal data structures for cache management.

classes.name: HttpAuthCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of HTTP authentication entries, supporting lookup, addition, removal, and cache management.

classes.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry
classes.description: Represents an individual HTTP authentication cache entry, including realm, credentials, scheme, and associated paths.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry(const Entry& other)
methods.description: Copy constructor for Entry.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry::~Entry()
methods.description: Destructor for Entry.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry::scheme_host_port()
methods.description: Returns the scheme, host, and port of the server.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry::realm()
methods.description: Returns the realm string of the challenge.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry::scheme()
methods.description: Returns the authentication scheme.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry::auth_challenge()
methods.description: Returns the authentication challenge string.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry::credentials()
methods.description: Returns the login credentials.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry::IncrementNonceCount()
methods.description: Increments and returns the nonce count.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry::UpdateStaleChallenge()
methods.description: Updates the challenge string and resets nonce count.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry::IsEqualForTesting()
methods.description: Checks equality with another Entry for testing purposes.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::HttpAuthCache(bool key_server_entries_by_network_anonymization_key)
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with keying behavior based on network anonymization key.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::~HttpAuthCache()
methods.description: Destructor for HttpAuthCache.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::SetKeyServerEntriesByNetworkAnonymizationKey()
methods.description: Sets whether server entries are keyed by NetworkAnonymizationKey.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Lookup()
methods.description: Finds a realm entry based on server, realm, scheme, and network key.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::LookupByPath()
methods.description: Finds an entry based on server, path, and network key.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Add()
methods.description: Adds or updates an auth cache entry.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Remove()
methods.description: Removes an entry if credentials match.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::ClearEntriesAddedBetween()
methods.description: Clears entries added within a time range.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::ClearAllEntries()
methods.description: Clears all cache entries.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::UpdateStaleChallenge()
methods.description: Updates a stale challenge for a server entry.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::CopyProxyEntriesFrom()
methods.description: Copies proxy entries from another cache.

methods.description: Returns size of cache for testing.

methods.description: Sets the tick clock for testing.

methods.description: Sets the clock for testing.
